entities.summary: Stan Lai (b. 1954-10-25, Washington, D.C.) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Washington, D.C. and Taiwan. Known in the fields of taiwan, poets & playwrights, asia.
